convert2shaDow: convert a graph dataset from SAINT or OGB format to shaDow-GNN format
test_ShaDowFiles_have_all_files: test if all required shaDow dataset files exist in a given directory prefix
cleanup_shaDow: delete a converted shaDow dataset directory after verifying raw data exists
build_data_zoo_lookup: build a lookup of supported datasets with their source format and prediction task specs
precompute_data: precompute undirected adjacency matrices for large datasets to speed up training
